metadata.title: Sorafenib Therapy
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain unassessed and do not block a partial result.

provenance.source: NCCP regimen PDF / Head and Neck catalogue

metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Organ-function values or categories are optional; omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.label: Source-reconciled organ-function encoding · clinical/pharmacy review pending

organ_function_reconciliation.note: Structured renal/hepatic component rules were reconciled to the current official NCCP regimen source. Independent Consultant and oncology-pharmacy validation remains pending.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: The treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist or other appropriately authorised specialist named in the current NCCP source.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Use the most restrictive applicable component rule and confirm dose changes against the current official NCCP PDF.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding includes NCCP 00294 Version 4. It does not replace the current official regimen, prescribing review, pharmacy verification or independent clinical judgement.
clinical_governance.organ_function_rule_status: Source reconciled in SACTCheck v0.59.0; independent Consultant and oncology-pharmacy validation pending.

indications.description: Advanced renal-cell carcinoma in an NCCP-listed sorafenib indication.
Progressive, locally advanced or metastatic differentiated thyroid carcinoma refractory to radioactive iodine.

hypersensitivity.label: Known hypersensitivity to a regimen component

proteinuria_grade.label: Proteinuria grade

options.label: Grade 1 — Mild
options.description: Dipstick 1+ or protein below 1.0 g per 24 hours.

options.label: Grade 2 — Moderate
options.description: Dipstick 2+ or 3+, or protein 1.0 to under 3.5 g per 24 hours.

options.label: Grade 3 — Severe
options.description: Protein 3.5 g or more per 24 hours or dipstick 4+; quantify according to the protocol.

options.label: Grade 4 — Life-threatening
options.description: Grade 4 is not defined under the CTCAE proteinuria term; use the appropriate renal-disorder term for life-threatening renal consequences.

proteinuria_grade.assessment_guidance: Use urine protein quantification and clinical consequences; dipstick alone may require confirmatory UPCR or 24-hour urine assessment.

major_bleeding_or_recent_thrombosis.label: Major bleeding, recent arterial thrombosis or clinically unstable venous thrombosis

recent_or_planned_major_surgery.label: Recent or planned major surgery / unhealed wound

alt_ast_uln_multiple.label: ALT / AST result (actual values entered; highest ×ULN calculated automatically)

bilirubin_uln_multiple.label: Bilirubin result (actual value entered; ×ULN calculated automatically)

oral_toxicity_grade.label: Worst treatment-related oral targeted-therapy toxicity

options.label: Grade 1 — Mild
options.description: Grade 1 under the named CTCAE term: generally mild or asymptomatic, with observation only and no intervention indicated.

options.label: Grade 2 — Moderate
options.description: Grade 2 under the named CTCAE term: generally moderate; local/non-invasive intervention may be indicated and instrumental activities may be limited.

options.label: Grade 3 — Severe
options.description: Grade 3 under the named CTCAE term: severe or medically significant; hospital care may be indicated and self-care activities may be limited.

options.label: Grade 4 — Life-threatening
options.description: Grade 4 under the named CTCAE term: life-threatening consequences; urgent intervention required.

oral_toxicity_grade.assessment_guidance: Identify and grade the specific toxicity using its CTCAE definition; assess symptoms, intervention and functional impact.

output_templates.proceed: No encoded restriction was triggered in the entered domain(s). This is not an overall treatment clearance.
output_templates.coverage_gap: Only entered values were assessed; omitted clinically relevant domains remain unassessed.
output_templates.consultant_review: The entered value requires protocol-specific Consultant/pharmacy review.
output_templates.withhold: Withhold treatment and reassess according to the official NCCP pathway.
output_templates.omit: Omit the relevant scheduled dose and reassess according to the official NCCP pathway.
output_templates.contraindicated: The entered value triggers an encoded contraindication/exclusion.
output_templates.permanently_discontinue: The entered value triggers permanent discontinuation in the encoded pathway.
